title: Ankerstein set/inventory catalog (ankerstein-sets.json)
description: The real 'set inventory' layer — which stones, and how many of each, make up a given historical or modern Ankerstein set (e.g. 'Nr. 5A', 'GK 2', '2A'). Distinct from ankerstein-shapes.schema.json (the stone/part library itself, set-independent) and from a scene (one specific build, see spex-ankerstein's scene.rs) — mirrors LDraw/Rebrickable's own part-vs-set-vs-model split (see BRICKs.md's 'Set number' entry). Every entry's sourceCitation is mandatory, same rule as the shape catalog.

setId.description: The set's own historical/commercial designation, e.g. '5A', 'GK2', '2A'. Not necessarily unique across GK/KK — pair with `caliber` to disambiguate.

displayName.description: Human-readable name/description of the set, e.g. 'Ergänzungskasten Nr. 5A'.

isSupplementSet.description: True for an Ergänzungskasten/supplement set (extends a lower-numbered base set rather than standing alone) — optional, only set when actually known.

contents.description: Which stones this set contains, and how many of each.

shapeId.description: References an `id` in ankerstein-shapes.json — not enforced by this schema alone (no cross-file $ref, per this project's self-contained-schema convention), checked by whatever loads both files at once.

sourceCitation.description: Mandatory: where this set's real composition was sourced from — a CVA catalog entry, a manufacturer's page, or a real box/Bauanleitung actually in hand.
